subject: Project Zero Hour — Session scheduling, owner assignments, and bridge plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mediasys.com>, Tom Dunn <tdunn@mediasys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Project Zero Hour — session scheduling, owner assignments, and bridge plan

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. To get the Project Zero Hour kickoff on calendars and make the first session productive, I put together two short options and a suggested owner map. Please pick which time works best for your team and confirm attendees:

Proposed first-session windows (60 minutes):
- Option A: Wed Mar 24, 10:00–11:00 PT (best for engineering leads)
- Option B: Thu Mar 25, 14:00–15:00 PT (better for product/stakeholders in ET)

What we want to accomplish in session #1:
- Introductions and success criteria (10m)
- Architecture overview + data flow for proof-of-concept (20m)
- Roles & immediate next steps / mutual action plan (20m)
- Q&A and scheduling of dry-run (10m)

Suggested Redwood owners:
- Diego Fernandez — kickoff host & success criteria
- Marissa Cole — implementation lead (run the dry-run and onboarding checklist)
- Ben Carter — runtime / infra liaison (bridge & access)
- Grace O'Connor — customer enablement and training follow-up

Attachments: Agenda_Project_Zero_Hour_v1.pdf (draft), Attendee_Roster_ProjectZero.xlsx (starter list), Bridge_Link_Details.txt (recommended bridge + fallback)

A couple of quick questions for you:
1) Do you need procurement on the first call or can we loop them after the demo?
2) Any additional technical attendees we should reserve time for (SRE, network)?

Samira — if you reply with the preferred option and final attendee list I will lock the calendar and send invites + a short pre-read.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mediasys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Dunn <tdunn@mediasys.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Zero Hour — session scheduling, owner assignments, and bridge plan

Diego —

Thanks — both options look doable. Preference is Option B (Thu Mar 25, 14:00–15:00 PT) because our product and analytics stakeholders are only available in that slot.

Attendees from MediaSys we will bring:
- Samira Khan (PM, integration owner)
- Tom Dunn (Head of Data Platforms)
- Kevin Liu (SRE) — will want 10 minutes for network/access discussion
- procurement@mediasys.com (procurement) — they prefer to be present for pricing/contract items, but if we can keep the first session focused on technical alignment, they can be briefed afterward.

Also: we prefer Microsoft Teams for the org, but we can join your bridge as long as you include dial-in details. If possible, please send both bridge and Teams dial-in in the invite.

I reviewed the draft agenda and added a small ask: can we include 5 minutes at the end to agree on the decision criteria for the POC (what success looks like, acceptance gates)?

If you send the invite I will confirm with Kevin about the network diagram he wants ready.

—Samira
Director, Product
MediaSys

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mediasys.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Tom Dunn <tdunn@mediasys.com>, procurement@mediasys.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Zero Hour — session scheduling, owner assignments, and bridge plan

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Samira. Option B works for our internal team as well. Diego, I'll take the action to create the calendar invite and include both our bridge + a Teams dial-in in the body.

A few operational notes before we finalize:
- Diego, can you confirm the bridge owner (Ben is listed but please set the bridge so Ben and I both have host controls).
- Ben, please prepare a short <5-slide> runbook we can share during the call that covers expected network ports, IP allow-listing, and credentialing steps.
- Grace, please prepare a 10-minute enablement deck that covers onboarding milestones and training options post-POC.

Pre-read to attach to the invite (I'll upload to Drive and link in the calendar):
- Agenda_Project_Zero_Hour_v1.pdf (Diego's draft)
- Attendee_Roster_ProjectZero.xlsx (Samira's list + internal owners)
- Basic network checklist (Ben's runbook)

Dry-run: let's schedule a 30-minute dry-run on Tue Mar 30 (11:00–11:30 PT). If that conflicts with MediaSys calendars we can move to Apr 1. Dry-run will be internal only (Redwood hosts) to validate slide order, screen shares, and bridge controls.

I'll send the invite in the next hour with the attachments and Drive links. Diego I will BCC the procurement alias so they have visibility but won't need to speak in the first meeting unless Samira asks otherwise.

Thanks —Marissa
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Dunn <tdunn@mediasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@mediasys.com>
Cc: procurement@mediasys.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Zero Hour — session scheduling, owner assignments, and bridge plan

Marissa / Diego —

Confirmed: MediaSys will join Thu Mar 25, 14:00–15:00 PT. We appreciate you including both bridge and Teams dial-in. Kevin (SRE) will bring a short network diagram; I will circulate any procurement constraints after the first call.

One last ask: can you capture the decision criteria we discussed (POC success gates) in the invite or as a one-pager in Drive? That will help ensure the right stakeholders stay for the necessary parts.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Tom Dunn
Head of Data Platforms
MediaSys
